ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   C. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   B. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

6. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   D. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   D. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

10. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   D. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.
   B. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   B. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   D. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: Ibadah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Adalah, Justice 02 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam, Intoxicants 03 5.4 Israf,extravaga and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Israf,extravagance 02 5.5 Dua 02 Page 11 of 73 xi 6 Muamalat 6.1 Fair treatment  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Fair treatment of workers 03 6.2 Relationship with people of other faiths 03 6.3 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
